guidance.title: Inyigisho
guidance.introduction: Urwego runo runyanye abahanga mu mahoro n'amakoperative akiyitiko amanota ya karuboni. Niba utera ibigera cyangwa ibiti bikamagana gusezerera umwuka, urwego runo rugufasha kumarira amafaranga ku bucuruzi bwacu.
guidance.step1_description: Ongera amakuru y'UPI kugira ngo wemeze ko akarima ni kacu. Ibi birava imenyekanisha no kwihishe amakuru.
guidance.step2_description: Cukura amafoto meza yibigera cyangwa ibiti byamagana gusezerera karuboni. Yashyiza ibiho ku kwemeza.
guidance.step3_description: Nyuma yo kurondekaburema, ikintu cyacu kidafasha kubungabunga umwuka kigenerera amanota iherezo ry'ibigize.
guidance.step4_description: Amakoperative akinna amanota kugira ngo magence gasezererwa. Wamarira amafaranga akajya mu konti yacu.
guidance.contribution: Ikintu cyacu kirabishe. Buri muti, buri bigera, buri mero y'akarima karimo gushora imbaraga mu kwangikira umwuka ni inzira yo kuri karere kirukiza. Mwacu kuzigamira!

admin.faq_ai_scoring: Umuntu akora gute sisitemu ya AI y'Gupima Amanota?
admin.faq_ai_scoring_answer: Sisitema ya AI isomera inyandiko zashyizweho n'amakuru y'umukoresha kugira ngo wemeze ubwoko bw'imyanzuro. Isondera ubwoko bwinyandiko, iguhitamo amakuru y'umukoresha no kwiyandikisha ibikenewe. Sisitema ihatanga imvugurumibare y'ubwoko n'igitekerezo cy'admin.
admin.faq_farmer_docs_answer: Ababimyi bakeneye gutanga: Ubwiyunge bw'Akarima/Akayandikisho, Amafoto yabimyi, Inyandiko y'uburimyi (amezi 3 ashize), no Ubwiyunge bw'aho haba. Inyandiko zose zikeneye gukora neza no kureba.
admin.faq_create_listing: Ubwiyunge n'uko mikora inyandiko nshya y'amanota?
admin.faq_create_listing_answer: Kugenda Kuguza Amanota > Rikora Inyandiko Nshya. Uzuza izina ry'inyandiko, hitamo umwanya, injiza umubare n'igiciro k'amanota. Reba agaciro rusesuye kandi shyizaho. Amanota agakora hari kugura mwigishumi.
admin.faq_commission_answer: Amafaranga yo guza atanuka mu mwanya: Umubimyi (5%), Amadozike (6%), Amagari ya Hybiride (4%), Ubucuruzi (7%). Ibyo bihurwa mu guza buri ikindi.
admin.faq_wallet_source: Amanota yo mu konti ya mwenyikazi ashyira ahe?
admin.faq_wallet_source_answer: Amanota y'admin konti iyerekeye abakoresha bacitswe neza bakabona kubyakore (uburimyi, amadozike, ...). Sisitema ikuranya amanota ikabiteka kubikorwa.
admin.faq_payouts_answer: Ibibazo bigahagurangira iherezo ry'umwanya no kuri amagenamiterere y'amafaranga. Kwemeranya bwa kwezi kigatekerera guhagurangira kuri mwanya wose.
admin.faq_manage_users_answer: Mu Sisitemu Abakoresha, urashobora kureba abakoresha bose bakiyandikisha, guhitamo mu mwanya no imikorere, kandi gukora ibikorwa nka guhagarika cyangwa gusiba konti. Kubikorera ikintu cy'ibikorwa mu rworozi rw'umukoresha.
admin.faq_user_statuses_answer: Ikorera: Umukoresha nicitswe kandi ashobora guza. Igisubizo: Gisubiza kwemeza. Yatiriwe: Konti ihagaze. Idakorera: Umukoresha nta nkundo z'ibikorwa mu mahoro 60+.

landing.hero_description: Inzira y'ibiyunguruzi ituma projeti ndogo za karuboni (inzira ndogo, imwe n'imwe, itunga rya koperative, abakoresha ba kitche byoroshye, aba muti bateanga, abakoresha ba biogaz, abakoresha ba solarite) kunegura, kwemeza, gufata hamwe, no guzitiza amanota ya karuboni kuva ku website cyangwa porogaramu y'ibinyamakuru.
landing.bridge_gap: Tuwambuka ubwavu burimo abafatabugurera n'inzira y'ibigize mu nzira y'isi tuzigira hamwe utubwire.
landing.nature_backed_desc: Amanota ayakozwe kuva icyo kabuye icyo kayoboye no aho mwajya kureba mu nzira, si gusa icyo gishishiruwe.
landing.grower_first_desc: Igiciro kiza, imihoro yubwire, no kurera aba mitereri. Tuzigira igiciro cyorosha cya kiri mu nzira.
landing.market_grade_desc: Inyandiko zirimo kwemezwa, amanota ayoboye, no inzira y'isoko yemezwa kubafatanye bakoresheje.
landing.register_parcel_desc: Projeti zigwira inyandiko z'ibikorwa bija icyara, ubwiyunge, no kumarira amanota
landing.verify_quantify_desc: Tukora gato kuburezi bwa karuboni no kureba mu nzira kugufasha kugenereza amanota.
landing.buy_retire_desc: Isosiyete igura amanota irecira inaremeza kunyuma y'ibigize muburezi.
landing.join_hundreds: Injiza na makoperative n'ibihumbi by'injira bivugira itanuka ryo mu gihe cy'amakuru.
landing.empower_land: Kwita aba mitereri n'isosiyete mubisogano bya karuboni — nta mahoro, nta mahoro, no mu bukungu.
